steps.en: A success result is built once the reduction is saved
steps.id: Hasil sukses dibuat setelah pengurangan tersimpan

steps.en: PLUS receives a success message right away
Success is only reported when a reduction really happened
steps.id: Sukses hanya dilaporkan bila pengurangan benar-benar terjadi
steps.why_en: A notice already reduced also gets a success message, though nothing was changed by the new request.
steps.why_id: Notice yang sudah dikurangi juga dapat pesan sukses, padahal request baru tidak mengubah apa pun.
